summary: Vox Royalty Corp., a gold & silver royalty company, filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements and MD&A for Q1 2026. The filing is a routine quarterly report with no transaction or special-situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is disclosed. The filing is a standard periodic update for a foreign private issuer.
